messages:
Sofia: Hi everyone  first week! Quick setup questions: 1) My monitor says "No Signal" when connected to the dock HDMI port but laptop charges fine. 2) I requested split-tunnel VPN access for internal dev tools — who handles that? Also my welcome box tracking number ended with 'LATE' on the courier site, any advice?

sam_it: Welcome Sofia! For the monitor: can you confirm the dock model on the label and try switching the HDMI cable to the other monitor port? Also unplugging the dock power and replugging sometimes forces the display handshake. Which OS are you on?

Sofia: Dock model is RW-ProDock-3. MacBook Pro (Ventura). Tried cable swap and port swap, still "No Signal" from that HDMI port. USB-C video on the other port works though.

it-bot: New IT ticket created: #46871 "ProDock-3 HDMI port no signal; welcome kit delayed" assigned to sam_it.

sam_it: Thanks. We'll door-test the unit. Short term: use the USB-C Alt Mode port or the DisplayPort adapter in the kit. For the shipping: can you DM the tracking link? I'll ping facilities to chase.

Sofia: DMed tracking: https://ship.fastcourier/track/RED-789-LATE  courier updated "delayed due to routing". Also curious about split-tunnel: I need access to internal Docker registries without routing IDE traffic through corp VPN.

it-ops: Ping @platform-security for split-tunnel exceptions. They typically require a short justification and device compliance (Intune). Provide the registry FQDNs and we'll request an allowlist entry. Quick note: we only permit split-tunnel for specific services and require mTLS to the registry.

sam_it: I checked the dock serial in our asset DB and flagged it as "test-fail HDMI". We can swap the dock for a tested unit. Are you SF office or remote? If SF, we can do front desk exchange today. If remote, we'll ship next-day with prepaid label for return.

Sofia: Remote in Portland. Please ship replacement. Also while I'm here  who do I ask about Slack channel access for #eng-private? My request still says pending.

sam_it: Shipping scheduled, ETA 2 business days. For Slack access, ping onboarding@redwood or DM me your request and I'll escalate once the device shows compliant in Intune.

it-bot: Ticket #46871 status updated: in_progress -> awaiting_shipment.

Sofia: Thanks all. One tiny follow-up  my keyboard occasionally types extra characters after waking from sleep (double letters). Any quick mac prefs to try?

sam_it: In the short term disable "Key Repeat" and toggling "Delay Until Repeat" (System Settings > Keyboard). If it persists, we'll remote in and check for USB input devices or firmware updates for the keyboard in the kit.

Sofia: Will try those settings and report back. Appreciate the quick help :smile:
